page.overview:
Who is Fight Force?

Guardians of the Globe|Enemies=Lizard League|Status=Possibly Active}}

Fight Force is a superhero group that is commonly mocked by other superheroes. Even though the team has been mentioned multiple times throughout the series they have not been seen inside of the show.

Although, not much is known about their history, when Atom Eve mentions the group to Mark Grayson while on the roof of their high school in the second episode, Mark replies saying he saw a video of Fight Force fighting the Lizard League.
